title: Grand Aqueduct Reservoir
author: Inbar Rose
architectNote: The grand reservoir requires dual authorization. Claim the cyan terrace key first, then delve into the lower cisterns for the amethyst seal.

help.title: Level 36: Grand Aqueduct Reservoir
help.message: Unlock the cyan terrace gate to access the lower cisterns, then locate the amethyst key to open the grand spillway.
